epics.description: Capability allowing customers to export paid orders from their account page into a CSV file.

features.description: CSV export feature for paid customer orders on the account page.
features.name: Order Export

acceptanceCriteria: Given a customer on their account page with paid orders, When they export their orders, Then a file named orders-YYYY-MM-DD.csv is generated containing one row per order with order number, date, and total amount including VAT.
Given a customer with cancelled orders, When the order export is generated, Then cancelled orders are excluded from the file.
stories.aiReadyReason: Which delimiter (comma or semicolon) and file encoding should be used for the CSV export?
stories.description: Customers can export their paid orders as a CSV file from their account page. The file name must be orders-YYYY-MM-DD.csv. It contains one row per paid order with order number, date, and total amount including VAT. Cancelled orders are excluded. The delimiter and file encoding are not yet specified.
stories.iWant: to export my paid orders as a CSV file from my account page
stories.soThat: I can view and retain my paid order history offline

tasks.description: Implement the backend service to retrieve paid orders excluding cancelled ones and format rows with order number, date, and total amount including VAT. Pending PO decision on delimiter and encoding.
tasks.title: Implement backend order query and CSV generator

tasks.description: Add the export action on the customer account page to trigger file download with name orders-YYYY-MM-DD.csv.
tasks.title: Add export button and trigger to account page

tasks.description: Write integration and end-to-end tests to verify that paid orders are correctly included, cancelled orders are excluded, and the filename format is respected.
tasks.title: Verify CSV export acceptance criteria

stories.title: Export paid orders to CSV
